mission: Genentech pioneers biotechnology medicines for people with serious and life-threatening diseases.
description: Paid internship on GenAI applications at Genentech (Roche). Open student/graduate role listed on the official careers site — confirm location, dates, and eligibility on the posting before applying.

mission: Genentech discovers and develops medicines by pushing the boundaries of science for patients with serious disease.
position: Students & Graduates — open internship and early-career roles
description: Live board of Genentech student and graduate openings (internships, early talent). Browse current postings and apply only to roles that match your degree level and work authorization.

mission: NYGC advances genomic research to improve human health through technology, collaboration, and discovery.
position: Open research, computational, and operations roles
description: NYC-based genomics center hiring across research and computational biology. Review current openings on their careers page and apply to a specific listed role.

description: MSK posts research technician, specialist, and scientist roles supporting cancer biology and translational work in NYC. Pick a specific live posting from the careers portal.

position: Open research and scientific roles at Janelia
description: HHMI’s Janelia campus lists research and scientific openings. Check current postings for postdoc, specialist, and related opportunities.

mission: HHMI supports discovery science for the benefit of humanity.
position: Open HHMI careers (research and institute roles)
description: Institute-wide HHMI openings, including scientific and research-support roles. Confirm the specific position and location on the live listing.

mission: The Simons Foundation advances the frontiers of research in mathematics and the basic sciences.
description: NYC-area science philanthropy organization with research and related openings. Review current listings before applying.
